generation.method: offline deterministic SliceSimulation policy replay; actual browser run uses this fixed list and never reads state to schedule input
generation.policy: tap when ready/anchored or projectedY > 450 and vy > -125, minimum world-time separation 140ms
generation.command: pnpm exec tsx -e '<offline SliceSimulation seed31 policy replay>'

input.portrait: Playwright touchscreen.tap at viewport center x 0.5, y 0.72
input.desktop: Playwright mouse.click at viewport center x 0.5, y 0.72
input.replay: Playwright real pointer/touch click on visible #replay-button after terminal screenshot
